newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian zinc steady as world prices continue gains.
newsitem.headline: Indian zinc steady as world prices continue gains.

text.p: Indian base metals on Friday remained steady in a narrow price band on the local market, dealers said.
Demand from industrial consumers remained sluggish but limited supplies and a firm world market kept offerings down.

Copper was steady at 13,475 rupees per quintal after losing 25 rupees on Thursday. Tin was steady at 28,500 rupees, nickel at 33,200 rupees and aluminium at 7,700 rupees per quintal amid nominal trading.
Zinc was steady at 8,300 rupees per quintal but the undercurrent remained firm on reports of a fresh upsurge in the world market.
"Zinc prices in the world market has recently hit a seven-year high and is moving up further," one broker said.
Lead was quoted at the last level of 4,150 rupees per quintal.
